newsitem.title: USA: Market Facts stock rises on greater visibility.
newsitem.headline: Market Facts stock rises on greater visibility.

text.p: Market Facts Inc, which provides custom market research, said an increased awareness of the company among investors and market makers has helped propel the stock to record highs, rising seven to 41-1/2.
"Historically, we've been undervalued relative to our peer group," said president Thomas Payne in a telephone interview.
"Though there are no financial analysts who formally cover us, we've gained some additional awareness as a result of additional market makers in the last several months," he said.
He said there are currently five or six market makers in Market Facts' stock, up from two or three.
"We've had continued growth in revenues and earnings but, until now, have not been recognized by the market place," Payne said
News of the company's improved third-quarter results and two-for-one stock split, released in late October, were belatedly filtering into the market, Payne said.

Payne said his company is looking at expanding internationally. "We expect international to represent a significant portion of our future (growth) opportunities, but it would be difficult to say how fast major relationships might unfold," he said.
The company also is seeking ways to use technology to enhance its business. "We're exploring opportunities for conducting research on the Internet, for example," Payne said.
